Cassandra Irene Gonzalez was arrested Tuesday afternoon, October 20, 2026, at 3:03 p.m. on a felony drug charge, according to the Webb County Sheriff's Office Booking Jail Search.

Gonzalez faces one count of possession of a controlled substance, Penalty Group 1/1-B, under one gram — a state jail felony in Texas. No bond had been set at the time of booking.

The arresting agency was not listed in the booking record.

Possession of a controlled substance in Penalty Group 1/1-B under one gram carries a state jail felony punishment range of 180 days to two years in state jail and a fine of up to $10,000 upon conviction. An arrest is an allegation, and Gonzalez is presumed innocent unless proven guilty.
